purpose.zh: 坐着就能练大腿内侧力量
purpose.en: Build inner-thigh strength right from your chair.

text.zh: 双膝夹住瑜伽砖，用力夹5秒
text.en: Squeeze the yoga block between your knees for five seconds

text.zh: 坐直，双脚与髋同宽，手放在大腿上
text.en: Sit tall, feet hip-width apart, hands on your thighs.

text.zh: 放松一下再夹，保持正常呼吸
text.en: Ease off, squeeze again, and keep breathing normally.

cautions.zh: 大腿内侧或膝盖疼痛时减轻力度，仍痛就停止
cautions.en: Squeeze more gently if your inner thighs or knees hurt, and stop if the pain continues.
